result.title: Efficient Multi-View Generation with Iterative Global-Local Proxy Attention
result.comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Supplementary material is available as an ancillary file
result.summary: Generating consistent multi-view RGB images and normal maps from a single input image provides complementary appearance and geometric cues for 3D reconstruction. However, maintaining cross-view consistency requires information exchange across viewpoints, and dense cross-view attention becomes computationally expensive as the number of views and spatial resolution increase. In this paper, we propose Global-Local Proxy Attention (GLPA) to reduce cross-view communication costs while preserving fine-grained within-view processing. Specifically, GLPA retains full-resolution interactions within each view and uses compact global proxies for cross-view communication. To further leverage the exchanged information, GLPA incorporates iterative proxy refinement, which rebuilds the proxies from updated features and reuses the same attention parameters for subsequent interactions within a single denoising step. We evaluate GLPA on two structurally different diffusion backbones, FLUX and Stable Diffusion. Experiments on FLUX show that GLPA achieves a $2.65\times$ speedup in attention computation per denoising step over dense attention, while improving reconstruction IoU from 0.6849 to 0.7019 and reducing NVS LPIPS from 0.086 to 0.076. Results on Stable Diffusion further demonstrate the effectiveness of GLPA, with a $1.80\times$ attention speedup and improvements across all five quality metrics.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Global-Local Proxy Attention（GLPA）：在每个视角内保留全分辨率注意力，跨视角仅通过紧凑的全局 proxy 交换信息，并在单次去噪步内用更新后的特征重建 proxy、复用同一套注意力参数迭代精化；在 FLUX 与 Stable Diffusion 上取得注意力加速与质量提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“压缩 proxy 承载跨视角信息 + 迭代重建并复用参数”的机制，可能为 LVR 中多视图 latent 状态的紧凑交换与多步状态更新效率提供借鉴线索，但该文属图像生成任务，无推理状态或答案使用分析，需核查 proxy 是否保留任务必要细节。
